about: Every type diagnostic cohere reports in the root's two projects, tsconfig.standalone.json and tsconfig.node.json: the file, the code, how many, and why it's expected rather than a finding to fix. Load checks some programs in a view no file holds: the host axioms correct @types/node (internal/load/host_axioms.json), the regexp library corrects lib.es5.d.ts (internal/load/regexp_library.go), and Apple's bindings are served from the binary (internal/load/apple.go). Those stay where Load applies them, so what they decide differently is listed here, as are the true findings: deliberate refusals and files no test loads. cohere isn't run inside a Go test, since that would build cohere from its submodule and check the whole tree in one unit, so a job holds cohere's output equal to this list (the count job on #kyq0pyn), and TestTheExpectedDiagnosticsNameTheProjects holds each row to a real file in the project it names.
